title: Training at Camp Schwab

paragraphs.text: Each company spent eight days at the Counter-Guerrilla Warfare School in Okinawa’s Northern Training Area. The program included patrolling, a two-day guerrilla problem, day and night live firing, landmine and demolition instruction, and jungle lanes.

notes: Individual company training dates remain to be established.
Map destination is a contextual location view, not the exact position of each action.
